settings.text: Jake Langley, founder of Luma Nutrition

settings.repere: Titre H2 · I couldn’t find a brand I trusted. So I
settings.text: I couldn’t find a brand I trusted. So I built one.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It started with a supplement I almost bo
settings.text: It started with a supplement I almost bought for my parents. The label looked impressive. But I couldn’t find any test results, and the dose was a fraction of what the research used.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The Army drilled honor and integrity int
settings.text: The Army drilled honor and integrity into me. You don’t cut corners when people are counting on you. The supplement industry cut them everywhere I looked.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · So I built Luma to a higher standard: me
settings.text: So I built Luma to a higher standard: meaningful doses, independent testing on every batch, and verified results anyone can see.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Nothing goes in these bottles that I wou
settings.text: Nothing goes in these bottles that I wouldn’t give my family or take myself. We’ll never ask you to trust a claim we aren’t willing to prove.

settings.text: Questions? Reach out. I read and answer them.
